document_type: preregistered experiment configuration (M3 task Sec. 31/36); locked BEFORE any M3 scientific run

provenance.benchmark_hash_verification: sha256 of docs/phase_m1d/M1_D_Benchmark_Freeze.json re-computed at every driver start and matched before any run (inherited from M2 discipline)
provenance.m2_freeze_requirement: M2 frozen as RareTopo-M2-v0 at tag commit 0a00f44 with full pytest exit 0 (docs/phase_m2/M2_Freeze_Summary.md) BEFORE any M3 scientific work; verified at driver start
provenance.firewall_note: no M2 lambda retuning; no benchmark/config change; no policy learning; no joint mean/covariance/weight/component optimization; no component deletion; no global optimality claim; scalar isotropic control only

protocol_locked.pilot_rng_rule: np.random.default_rng([seed, 101]); frozen draw_mix_pilot order (target first, then current proposal); ONE shared pilot per (config, seed) reused for selection lock, gradient estimation, and Layer B refit -- zero extra simulator calls for the gradient
protocol_locked.rng_sequence_rule: counterfactual variants share CRN: identical component structure/order + fixed weights => rng.choice and standard_normal streams match; only the selected component Cholesky scaling differs
protocol_locked.eval_generator_rule: np.random.default_rng([seed, eval_rng_tag]); proposal.sample then log_density via frozen eval_proposal_is semantics

gradient_point_locked.definition: frozen M1-D variance-policy proposal immediately after the variance-critical component has been added and the frozen M1-v0 SLSQP mixture weights established, BEFORE any M3 covariance change (task Sec. 16)
gradient_point_locked.selected_component_covariance_at_gradien: Sigma_base read from frozen proposal metadata (= I_2 unit family, metadata-certified; never hardcoded without check)
layer_A_locks: all mixture weights (= pi_C0 frozen SLSQP output)

gradient_formula_locked.responsibility: r_k(x) = pi_k q_k(x) / q(x), 0<=r<=1, sum r = 1
gradient_formula_locked.matrix_candidate_theorem: grad_{Sigma_k} M2 = (M2/2) Sigma_k^{-1} [ E_nuV[r_k] Sigma_k - E_nuV[r_k (X-m_k)(X-m_k)^T] ] Sigma_k^{-1}
gradient_formula_locked.stationary_target: T_k = E_nuV[r_k (X-m_k)(X-m_k)^T] / E_nuV[r_k]; stationary condition Sigma_k = T_k under fixed (m, pi)

finite_sample_estimator.a_i: 1_A(x_i) p(x_i)^2 / (q(x_i) r_i(x_i)) on the shared pilot (frozen variance-mass importance values; recorded source density r_i at draw time)
finite_sample_estimator.responsibility_hat: pi_k q_k(x_i)/q(x_i) evaluated at the gradient-point mixture (unit covariances)

ess_grad.weights_c: c_i = a_bar_i rhat_ki / sum_j a_bar_j rhat_kj

bootstrap_locked.scheme: frozen fixed-stratified bootstrap (mirrors hyptraj.m1.variance_measure.omega_bootstrap_lcb resampling discipline): resample WITHIN p-source stratum and WITHIN q-source stratum, preserve stratum sizes exactly, recompute g_hat per replicate
bootstrap_locked.headline_rule: point-sign alone never used in headline experiments

step_policy_locked.theta_definition: theta_k = log s_k^2; s_new^2 = s_old^2 * exp(+-delta_theta)
step_policy_locked.legality_rule: every perturbed component covariance passes the FROZEN checker (min eig >= LEGALITY_MIN_EIG = 0.5 of hyptraj.m1.proposal_update, verbatim reuse); e^{+/-0.40} * I_2 min-eig = 0.670 >= 0.5 so all preregistered steps are legal by construction; any violation recorded HOLD_INVALID

comparators_locked.rule: fixed -0.20 isotropic on the selected component only
fixed +0.20 isotropic on the selected component only
CI-sign decision; step +-0.20 in predicted direction; otherwise HOLD

counterfactual_protocol_locked.pred_opposite_mapping: if GRADIENT predicts WIDEN: pred=WIDEN arm, opposite=SHRINK arm; if SHRINK: reversed; CRN-matched

evaluation_best_direction.WIDEN: M2(widen) < M2(base) AND M2(widen) < M2(shrink) with relative tie tolerance
evaluation_best_direction.SHRINK: M2(shrink) < M2(base) AND M2(shrink) < M2(widen) with relative tie tolerance
evaluation_best_direction.HOLD: neither perturbation improves base by > relative_tie_tolerance

simulator_call_accounting_locked.scientific_audit_calls_per_trial: pilot_n + 3 * final_eval_n = 320000 (one shared pilot + independent evaluations of BASE/WIDEN/SHRINK diagnostic arms)
simulator_call_accounting_locked.deployable_method_calls_per_trial: pilot_n + chosen_GRADIENT_action_path_final_eval = 120000 (pilot + one evaluation of the action the deployable method would take; opposite-direction scientific diagnostics NOT counted toward deployable VRF)

primary_metrics_locked: direction accuracy Acc_dir among active trials
predicted-step success rate P(M2(pred)<M2(base)) among active trials

m2_diagnostic_locked.purpose: for each M3 trial compute the FAILED M2 descriptive HDR covariance C_eta_k^V for reporting only; NEVER used for control (task Sec. 17)
m2_diagnostic_locked.reported_conflict_case: M2 descriptive covariance suggests narrowing (tr(C_eta)<trace/scale below base) while M3 gradient predicts WIDEN
m2_diagnostic_locked.estimator_source: hyptraj.m2.variance_covariance.estimate_variance_region verbatim on the same shared pilot

gates_locked.M3_0_validity: M2 frozen; parent tags unchanged incl. RareTopo-M2-v0; task committed before runs; derivation present; no oracle leakage into estimators; fixed-weight Layer A; full pytest pass

advantage_comparator_definition_locked: nonadaptive comparator = ALWAYS-WIDEN vs ALWAYS-SHRINK direction accuracies measured on the SAME active-trial set; advantage computed against the better (max) of the two fixed rules
amendment_policy_locked: any change to any locked constant above requires docs/phase_m3/M3_PREREG_AMENDMENT_<date>.md with old/new/reason/outcome-inspection/untouched-rerun fields, committed BEFORE further runs
